landing-hero-1: Adapt your CV to any job offer in
landing-hero-paragraph: Our AI analyzes the job offer and optimizes your CV to pass ATS filters and stand out to recruiters.
landing-problem-paragraph: 75% of CVs are never seen by a human. Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) reject profiles that don't exactly match the job description.
landing-problem-text: You use the same CV for 50 jobs. Keywords don't match, the format is confusing to the software, and you end up in the digital trash without even a call.
landing-solution-text: We adapt your experience dynamically. Our AI rewrites your achievements using the language of the job offer, ensuring ATS marks you as an "Ideal Candidate".
landing-steps-subtitle: Your new job is just three clicks away.
landing-step-1-text: Upload your current profile or create one from scratch on our intuitive platform.
landing-step-2-text: Enter the vacancy text from LinkedIn, Indeed or any portal that interests you.
landing-step-3-text: Receive a personalized CV with strategic keywords, ready to send.
landing-feature-1-text: We automatically identify the technical and soft skills the recruiter is really looking for.
landing-feature-2-text: Get a real-time score of how likely your CV is to pass automated filters.
landing-feature-3-text: Clean, minimalist designs 100% readable for machines and humans.
landing-feature-4-text: Edit and adjust AI suggestions on the fly while viewing the final result.
landing-cta-final-title: Don't let a filter stop you.
landing-cta-final-text: Get your interview today with the most advanced CV optimization tool on the market.
